$comment: An importable example company for the Cognee company-memory plugin: research → product decision → marketing brief. Ids are stable UUIDs so the walkthrough's config and curl commands line up. Seed it into a dev host with `paperclipai` (see README.md in this folder) or into the SDK test harness (tests/live/live.test.mjs uses the same shapes).

issues.title: Interview 12 onboarding drop-off customers
issues.description:
Findings: 9 of 12 interviewed customers abandoned onboarding at the password step; 7 cited password-manager friction on mobile; 4 asked for a magic link. Support tickets tagged 'password reset' were 31% of onboarding tickets in September. Transcripts: research-drive/onboarding-2026-09.

#remember Password friction is the leading onboarding drop-off cause (9/12 interviews, 31% of onboarding tickets).

issues.title: Decide the onboarding login method
issues.description: Decision: ship passwordless magic-link login as the default onboarding path in Q4; keep password login behind 'Other options'. Rationale: RES-1 evidence (password friction leading drop-off cause) and the support cost of resets. Risks: email deliverability; mitigated with a resend flow.

issues.title: Write the launch brief for passwordless onboarding
issues.description: Draft the launch brief. Use cognee_recall first: the research evidence (RES-1) and the product decision (PROD-7) are in company memory. Cite both tasks.

comments.body: #remember Magic-link login is the default onboarding path from Q4 2026; password login stays available under 'Other options'. Evidence: RES-1 interviews and September support-ticket share.
